entries.name: Focus

entries.ready_note: Focus modes (Do Not Disturb on, off, scheduled) are built in the shell and tested in shell::focus.

entries.name: FocusSettingsUI

entries.name: FontServices
entries.note: private framework, owner CoreText; from SDK matrix core-text.json
entries.ready_note: The font service's job is the catalogue and matching of fonts. FontManager registers installed and app-supplied faces and matches a FontSpec (fontobj), the user's font choice is kept per role (fontprefs, UserFonts), unknown family names resolve to open equivalents by class with a fallback cascade (font_substitution), and the Font Book app lists and validates the library. Open: OpenType shaping and bidirectional layout, recorded in the Core Text SDK row.

entries.name: FoundInAppsPlugins
entries.note: Apps index their own items and the Search panel lists matches under Documents, opening them in the app. Gap: there is no plugin point that lets an app add results from its own search code. Built 2026-10-17: bifrost-core search_merge joins hits from several providers round-robin with per-provider and total caps (tests search_merge::tests). Open: no app-side provider call yet.
entries.ready_note: The job is showing items that apps hold in the system search. Apps index their own items (sdk quicksearch), the shell's search index lists them under Documents and opens them in the app (spotindex), and results from several providers merge round-robin with per-provider and total caps (core search_merge). Open: an app-side provider call so an app answers a query from its own search code.

entries.name: FoundationODR
entries.note: private framework, owner Foundation; from SDK matrix foundation-app-support.json, foundation-files-persistence.json, foundation-fundamentals.json, foundation-networking-lowlevel.json Built 2026-10-17: OperationQueue on worker threads (sdk operation_queue, tests operation_queue::tests). Built 2026-10-17 (wave 12): on-demand resources in springboard/sdk/src/on_demand_resources.rs (tests on_demand_resources::tests). Open: the App Store fetch.
entries.ready_note: Built 2026-10-17: on-demand resources. A Catalog names tagged payloads (size, SHA-256, preservation priority); a ResourceStore fetches missing tags through a caller-supplied fetch, verifies and installs them atomically (background_download::stage), pins them for the life of a ResourceRequest (begin, conditionally begin, end accessing, progress) and purges unpinned tags under a disk budget, lowest preservation priority and least recently used first (on_demand_resources tests). Open: wiring a fetch to the PC App Store, and loading-priority scheduling.

entries.ready_note: The compositor's frame clock (vblank timestamps, each compose scheduled ahead of the next vblank) is tested in render_server::clock::tests. Verification on Midget is still open, so the row stays partial.

entries.name: FrontBoard
entries.note: The shell starts apps over a socket pair, holds each app's newest presented surface and gives every app its own resource ownership. Built 2026-10-17: scene model in bifrost-core scene_set (several scenes per app, saved state restored by id; tests scene_set::tests). Open: not wired into the app host yet.
entries.ready_note: The scene and process host: the shell starts apps and holds their presented surfaces (apphost, app_manager), the `scenes` shell service opens, lists, focuses, reopens and closes an app's scene windows (scene_services), the scene model keeps per-scene saved state restored by id (core scene_set), and apps receive the session lifecycle in order (sdk scene_session).

entries.name: FrontBoardServices
entries.note: Covers app process and surface lifecycle as in the shell app host and the per-app resource manager. Gap: no scene-level services; not verified on the lab machine.
entries.ready_note: The client services of the scene host: app process and surface lifecycle (apphost, per-app resource manager) and scene-level services through the `scenes` shell service (scene_services), with scene state in core scene_set. Not verified on the lab machine in this wave.

entries.name: FuseBoardServices

entries.name: FusionTracker
entries.note: n/a: sensor-fusion tracking for the vendor's camera, motion and depth hardware (an iOSSupport copy is present, which marks a device-class component). The index holds only Info.plist files. BifrOSt's motion and sensor APIs are separate and do not use this tracker.

entries.name: Futhark
entries.note: Apple recognition model pack: the reference holds only an Espresso recognition network and its weights, with no code naming the recognizer. Apple ML model packs are not reproduced.
